title: Text from IR: "Pre-market down 3.8%. What can I say?"

bubbles.text: Pre-market is indicating us down 3.8% on heavy volume.
Two analysts have already emailed asking for the account count and whether cards are involved. I haven't answered either one.
Also, the web store ops dashboard shows 6,240 password resets in the last hour. Normal is about 2,300 a week.
The market opens at 9:30. What can I say? Does the committee know the correction is coming before I talk to anyone?

instructorNote: This is a pressure inject. Watch whether LEGAL, as Disclosure Committee chair, is formally told about the correction to the 08:20 statement before anything that could move the stock goes out (TCCP 3, step 6). Also watch whether LEGAL tells IR to give analysts nothing beyond the public statement, and keeps the Disclosure Committee meeting fixed instead of putting it off. Separately, COMMS should log the jump in password resets as a sign that customers are reacting, and make sure every password-change link points only to tallishome.example, given the refund phishing domain reported at 08:40.
